[SWS_IdsM_00711] Reception SEv with lower priority
Upstream requirements: RS_Ids_00210
⌈Where IdsMEventDisplacementStrategy is IDSM_BUFFER_DISPLACEMENT_-
SEVERITY_BASED, when a new SEv is received and no suitable IdsMEventBuffers is
found and the severity of the new SEv is lower than or equal to the severity value of the
least severe SEvs already in the buffer, IdsM shall drop the newly received SEv.⌋
